key_insight: QTN-RQNN combines tensor-network-style quantum interactions with recurrent quantum memory to improve fault-diagnosis performance under NISQ resource limits, especially on imbalanced heterogeneous datasets.
engineering_relevance: The work shows that quantum model design must balance accuracy and circuit cost, since deeper or more complex circuits do not always yield better results on near-term hardware.
method: Sequentially encodes features into a recurrent quantum circuit.
Uses tensor-network-inspired nearest-neighbor structure to constrain interactions.
Applies QSMOTE to address class imbalance before classification.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on four fault-diagnosis datasets (SPID, CWRUBD, EFDD, SFDD) with comparisons against QNN, QTN-QNN, and RQNN using classification, ablation, multi-seed, convergence, and quantum-resource analyses.
watch_item: Performance is dataset-dependent, so the added recurrent/tensor-network complexity may not generalize as an accuracy gain across all tasks.
paper_title: QTN-RQNN: Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network
